ارجحنا (form IVq)
# اِرْجَحَنَّا (irjaḥannā) /ir.d͡ʒa.ħan.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# اِرْجَحِنَّا (irjaḥinnā) /ir.d͡ʒa.ħin.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
